headline: Oils & Teas from the Tropics
subheadline: Sustainably sourced, ethically crafted. A curated selection of tropical oils and teas, especially from Africa.
tagline: Nature remembers, and so do we.
teaCtaSub: Whole-leaf character. Honest aroma. Taste of place.
teaEnjoyTitle: Enjoy a cup of tea with your loved ones
teaEnjoyBody: Pause the noise and gather close. Our herbal, green and black teas carry the quiet wisdom of the tropics—leaves picked at their peak, crafted to calm the mind and warm the spirit. Share a pot, breathe deeper, and let the cup do the caring.
oilsCtaSub: Cold-pressed goodness for scalp, skin, and kitchen.
oilsCareTitle: Nourish scalp & skin with 100% natural oils
oilsCareBody: From shea and coconut to castor and beyond our cold-pressed oils are crafted to soothe the scalp, seal in moisture and let your natural glow rise to the surface. Honest texture. Quiet shine. Care you can feel.
subscribeText: Get product updates, small-batch releases, and occasional perks.
